stem: ![](asset:P000486-stem-1)A block of mass ‘m’ placed on smooth plane inclined at an angle of 37° with the horizontal, is pushed up the slope from initial position of rest. The external force acting on the block is constant and equal to $mg$ in magnitude and horizontal in direction. Find the kinetic energy of the block when it reaches B at a height of ‘H’ from the initial position?

assets.alt: Block A at the bottom of an incline of 37°, pushed by a horizontal force equal to mg, moves up to position B at the top, a height H above.
